entries.en: Dammit... I wanna go home...
I don't wanna go to school...[n]This sucks...
I'm so tired every day...
I don't want to go to work...
Are there any[n]breaks coming up?
I heard there's a forum[n]about the Phantom Thieves.
Oh, I've seen him on TV!
entries.uk: О, я бачив його по телевізору!

entries.en: He's famous, but he still rides[n]the train like everyone else...
entries.uk: Він знаменитий, але досі їздить[n]поїздом, як усі...

entries.en: Hey, isn't that[n]that detective?
The Phantom Thieves[n]are kinda cool, huh?
I heard they caught[n]some criminal.
People are saying it was[n]foretold by a calling card...
Oh, I know about that![n]I saw them in Shibuya!
entries.uk: О, я знаю про це![n]Я бачив їх у Шібуї!

entries.en: That Phantom Thieves[n]forum is super active.
There's a forum!? What's[n]it called? I wanna see!
entries.uk: Є форум!? Як він[n]називається? Хочу глянути!

entries.en: Why haven't the Phantom[n]Thieves said anything?
Having your money stolen[n]sounds terrifying...
entries.uk: Коли в тебе крадуть гроші —[n]це, мабуть, жахливо...

entries.en: It's unsettling not knowing[n]what they're going to do to us.
entries.uk: Тривожно не знати, що[n]вони з нами зроблять.

entries.en: They're declaring their[n]victory? What does that mean?
I really wish they'd[n]stop that...
At this rate they're gonna[n]end up attacking us...
I heard stocks are down.[n]Is that because of Medjed?
I really wish they[n]wouldn't do this...
I heard some other company's[n]private data got leaked...
entries.uk: Чув, у ще однієї компанії[n]злили приватні дані...

entries.en: What are the Phantom[n]Thieves doing!?
Eleven days until[n]Medjed's deadline...
Did the Phantom Thieves[n]just decide to ignore it?
entries.uk: Фантомні Злодії що, вирішили[n]просто це ігнорувати?

entries.en: I heard info about another[n]scandal got leaked...
entries.uk: Чув, злили відомості про[n]ще один скандал...

entries.en: Stocks have been[n]falling ever since.
Who's going to take[n]responsibility for this?
This is all the Okumura[n]Foods CEO's fault, right?
entries.uk: Це ж усе провина гендиректора[n]«Окумура Фудс», так?

entries.en: Why are the Phantom[n]Thieves letting him go?
Why bother with rankings!?[n]Hurry up and take him out!
entries.uk: Навіщо той рейтинг!?[n]Швидше розберіться з ним!

entries.en: I'm disappointed. What kind[n]of heroes are they?
Just get a move on and send[n]a calling card already.
I wonder what kind of[n]people the culprits are...
Probably some idiots with[n]a misguided sense of justice.
entries.uk: Мабуть, якісь дурні з[n]викривленим почуттям справедливості.

entries.en: Look, can they just arrest[n]those guys already?
Special Investigations[n]is on it. I'm sure they'll[n]be caught soon.
What kind of people [n]are they? I wanna see [n]what they look like.
entries.uk: Що вони за люди? [n]Хочу побачити, [n]який у них вигляд.
